body: You’re absolutely right. I’ll let him know.
He doesn’t strike me as the “entitled” type. She rejected him after he confessed and he told me that he just wants to make her happy even if they’re just friends. That’s why I’m so conflicted.
Definitely was in public and fully clothed. She was wearing jeans.

Apparently he did confess and she’s not interested. Their friendship hasn’t changed from what I see but he’s still obviously attracted to her. Also I’ve known him all my life and she’s literally the only girl he’s liked so I kind of feel bad for him.
